description: This Kotlin source file defines the OrderRepository class, which provides methods to create, fetch, update, and cancel orders via network API calls. It includes data classes for filtering and paginating orders, and extension functions for converting DTOs to domain models.

classes.name: OrderRepository
classes.description: Repository class handling order-related network operations, including creation, retrieval, status updates, and cancellation.

classes.name: OrderFilters
classes.description: Data class encapsulating optional filtering parameters for fetching orders.

methods.name: createOrder
methods.description: Creates a new order with specified email, items, coupon code, and payment info.

methods.name: getOrderById
methods.description: Retrieves an order by its ID.

methods.name: fetchOrdersPage
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of orders applying optional filters.
